final_text:
I've successfully sent an inquiry to New Car Rental's support team at support@newcarrental.co.uk (which was mentioned in a customer review as the contact for child-seat requests). 

The email asked about:
- Whether child seats are available at their London rental locations
- How to reserve a child seat
- Any associated costs

The email has been sent and I've received confirmation that it was delivered to support@newcarrental.co.uk. You should receive a response from their team regarding your inquiry about child seat availability.
